title: We keep finding new ways to bring AI into education
lead: Wicked Storm builds its own AI to support AX (AI transformation) in education. We try AI models for learning analytics and AI agents in education settings, and the LLM Wiki in our own work first, while people judge and apply.

ax.title: Education AX: from management to experience
ax.lead: We help learning platforms shift from management to experience. All learning activity is collected as learning data built on global standards, and AI analyzes it to suggest what administrators, instructors, and learners do next.

steps.title: Collect
steps.text: Collects and stores learning activity as learning data using global standards (xAPI · 1EdTech Caliper) and links it to 1EdTech CASE frameworks.

claims.text: AI finds anomaly signals in learning data,
and profiles learners with an LLM.

steps.title: Suggest
steps.text: On a teaching and learning platform where people interact with AI, it suggests next steps along with the evidence.

steps.title: Next semester
steps.text: People judge and apply. The results build up again as learning data and inform next semester’s learning design.

models.title: AI learning analytics: models we built, used in the field
models.lead: We build our own AI models that diagnose learning levels, find unusual signals, and read learner tendencies from learning data, and have applied them to our products and public education projects. You can check the certificate or patent behind each model.

items.name: Learning diagnosis and recommendation model
items.text: Diagnoses learning levels from learning behavior and experience data, and recommends items and learning content for weak areas. Applied to KERIS’s ‘Toc Toc! Math Expedition’.

items.name: Anomaly learning detection
items.text: Finds unusual learning signals in xAPI learning behavior data and flags where a closer look is needed first. Used in Lecognizer AI’s anomaly detection.

items.name: LLM-based learner profiling
items.text: Uses learning process data and an LLM to summarize learners’ tendencies and states, as a basis for customized diagnosis and item recommendations.

models.ruleLabel: A basis for teaching and learning
models.rule: AI diagnoses and suggests the next learning; instructors review it and apply it in class, and learners continue with the suggested learning on their own.

agent.title: AI agents: working alongside learners and instructors
agent.lead: In LearnHubble AI, AI agents give learners explanations and hints when they need them, and suggest to instructors what needs to be supplemented. Learners write their own answers, and instructors confirm interventions and what is applied.

items.title: Assignment hints
items.text: When writing stalls, gives structure-and-condition hints, not answers.

items.title: Classroom AI panel
items.text: Offers explanations, quizzes, and materials in sections the instructor designed.

items.title: Tracing difficulties
items.text: Helps trace the causes of difficulty through lectures and competencies linked by 1EdTech CASE.

items.title: Suggested supplements
items.text: Suggests what to supplement from the evidence, and the instructor decides whether and how to apply it.

wiki.title: LLM Wiki: scattered knowledge in one place
wiki.lead: We gather in-house documents, discussions, and answers to recurring questions into our LLM Wiki, and build AI into our workflows to refine the way we work.

map.label: Knowledge map: scattered documents, discussions, and recurring questions are woven into concepts (products, technology, standards, projects, certifications) and their relationships; AI finds materials along the link between standards and projects

screen.label: LLM Wiki example screen
screen.title: LLM Wiki
screen.a: It is used to exchange curricula, achievement standards, and competencies as one standard framework. Collected learning data points to items in that framework.

steps.title: Gather
steps.text: Documents, discussions, and answers to recurring questions that used to be scattered are kept in one place.

steps.title: Connect
steps.text: Documents and discussions are woven into concepts and relationships (an ontology), so anyone can ask for and find the knowledge they need.

steps.title: Draft, then decide
steps.text: AI finds and gathers relevant materials and creates a draft; the person in charge then reviews, edits, and finalizes it.

wiki.ruleLabel: The same principle as our products
wiki.rule: AI finds, organizes, and drafts. People decide what to use and how.

std.title: 1EdTech standards
std.lead: 1EdTech (formerly IMS Global) is the global consortium that develops EdTech standards. Wicked Storm is a founding board member of 1EdTech Korea and is active as a 1EdTech Contributing Member.
